chunks: A man asked al-Sadiq عليه السلام and said:
I eat while I am unsure about dawn. So he said: "Eat until you are no longer in doubt."

key_terms.أَشُكُّ: I am uncertain; I have doubt
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: dawn, the time at which fasting begins
key_terms.لَا تَشُكَّ: you are no longer in doubt

ai.seo_question: Can a fasting person continue eating if they are unsure whether dawn has begun?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning eating at the end of the night before dawn in fasting. It indicates that one may continue eating so long as the rise of dawn is not certain and mere doubt does not make eating impermissible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1962 - A man asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), "I eat while I am unsure if dawn has risen."
Imam (as) replied: "Eat until you are no longer in doubt."
